# Mod class for modular arithmetic
class Mod:
    mod = 1000000007
    
    def __init__(self, n=0):
        if isinstance(n, Mod):
            self.num = n.num
        else:
            self.num = (n % self.mod + self.mod) % self.mod
    
    def __add__(self, other):
        if isinstance(other, Mod):
            return Mod(self.num + other.num)
        else:
            return Mod(self.num + other)
    __radd__ = __add__
    
    def __sub__(self, other):

        else:
            return Mod(self.num - other)
    def __rsub__(self, other):
        if isinstance(other, Mod):
            return Mod(other.num - self.num)
        else:

    def __mul__(self, other):
        if isinstance(other, Mod):
            return Mod(self.num * other.num)
        else:

    __rmul__ = __mul__

    def __rtruediv__(self, other):
        return other * self.inv()
    
    def __pow__(self, power):

        base = self
        n = power

            base *= base
            n >>= 1
        return result
    
    def inv(self):
        return self.__pow__(self.mod - 2)
    
    def __int__(self):
